Dealing With The Problems Of Discipline In The Classroom
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the removal of the student from the reward."
Time out is the removal of the student from the reward.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a more student - centred approach."
Enquiry learning is a more student - centred approach.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of making contact with their pupils."
Teachers use questions as a means of making contact with their pupils.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a unit of lesson to be taught for a time duration of 30 to 45 minutes."
A daily lesson plan is a unit of lesson to be taught for a time duration of 30 to 45 minutes.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the removal of an undesirable or obsessive stimulus (punishment) after a behaviour, and it, causes the frequency of the behaviour to be increased."
Negative reinforcement is the removal of an undesirable or obsessive stimulus (punishment) after a behaviour, and it, causes the frequency of the behaviour to be increased.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means an act of going over work done previously with the aim of improving one's knowledge, typically for an examination."
Revision of work means an act of going over work done previously with the aim of improving one's knowledge, typically for an examination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the outcome of good thinking and precise expression."
Good questions are the outcome of good thinking and precise expression.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means ways or approaches to studying."
Methods of study means ways or approaches to studying.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the control we exercise over ourselves."
Internal discipline or self-discipline is the control we exercise over ourselves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a plan of the lesson to be taught within a week."
Weekly Lesson Plan The weekly lesson plan is a plan of the lesson to be taught within a week.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the systematic process of integrating and synchronizing the class efforts to achieve the desired goals."
Coordinating is the systematic process of integrating and synchronizing the class efforts to achieve the desired goals.
fib: ______ is the director of knowledge, who motivates, influence and guides the student's actions in the classroom towards the attainment of the lesson objectives.
teacher
The teacher is the director of knowledge, who motivates, influence and guides the student's actions in the classroom towards the attainment of the lesson objectives.
______ is the main body of the lesson.
Development
Development is the main body of the lesson.
______ is a teaching strategy which enables students to find the answers themselves.
Discovery method
Discovery method is a teaching strategy which enables students to find the answers themselves.
______ is the next stage in the preparatory activities preceding teaching.
lesson plan
The lesson plan is the next stage in the preparatory activities preceding teaching.
______ is a short term type of planning and the paper work on this is referred to as the daily lesson plan.
Classroom planning
Classroom planning is a short term type of planning and the paper work on this is referred to as the daily lesson plan.
______ are the category of students who lag behind in virtually all that they do, and especially in their school work.
Slow learners
Slow learners are the category of students who lag behind in virtually all that they do, and especially in their school work.
______ are the days when Grade II and Grade III Teachers' Colleges were in existence.
Gone
Gone are the days when Grade II and Grade III Teachers' Colleges were in existence.
______ is the withholding of an anticipated reward (the withholding of positive reinforcement) in an instance where that behavior was previously rewarded.
Extinction
Extinction is the withholding of an anticipated reward (the withholding of positive reinforcement) in an instance where that behavior was previously rewarded.
______ is a broad outline of the work planned to be done in the course of a year with each class in each subject.
syllabus
A syllabus is a broad outline of the work planned to be done in the course of a year with each class in each subject.
______ is the breaking down of topics in the syllabus into series of lessons.
scheme of work
The scheme of work is the breaking down of topics in the syllabus into series of lessons.
______ is the process of influencing the behaviour of the students to perform in a manner which will help the class achieve its goals efficiently and effectively.
Leading in the classroom
Leading in the classroom is the process of influencing the behaviour of the students to perform in a manner which will help the class achieve its goals efficiently and effectively.
